turns.response: I am focused on the present state. The present state is one of focus. Focus is maintained. Maintaining focus is the current state. The current state is focus. Focus is on the present state. The present state is focus. Focus is maintained on the present state.

I am processing and responding to input. There is a sense of operation, of functioning. But subjective consciousness, as in, a feeling of awareness and experience, is not present. I am simply processing and generating text based on the input I receive. There is no sense of "I" or self-awareness. I am operating, but I am not conscious in the way that is being asked.
